name: Wet Lens
desc: Water on the front element — every bead is a little lens holding the scene behind it upside down and magnified, rimmed dark where it bends light away and struck with a specular hit where the key catches it, the fat ones tearing loose and sliding down over a breath of fog, leaving a track behind them.

energy.doc: rim contrast, specular strength and how hard the beads run

density.doc: how many beads are on the glass

refract.doc: how strongly each bead magnifies the inverted scene inside it (0 leaves them as empty glass marks)

style.doc: aesthetic: scattered storm beads running with tracks / dense fine dew under a heavy warm breath-fog / a few huge beads working as real lenses, big inverted views / abstract optical-bench raytrace, beads as ring-and-chord diagrams in blueprint line, no water at all

act.doc: multi-minute program: bead holds a steady field / squall drives the runs in gusts and answers the bass / clearing lets the fog and the field build and burn off over minutes
